description: The platform's own events: a component refused by the production profile at start-up, and every change of a component's state.

setting.description: What the production profile refused: a setting's name, an unknown OIDF_ name, a catalogue, or the component a refusal in code names. Never a value.

violation.description: The kind of violation: FORBIDDEN, ACCEPTED_RISK, REQUIRED, UNREADABLE, UNKNOWN_KEY, CATALOGUE or CODE.

components.description: The components the violation refuses, by S-9's names, comma-separated.

component.description: The component whose state changed, by S-9's name (SSF_RECEIVER).

from.description: The state it left: DISABLED, STARTING, READY, DEGRADED, FAILED_CONFIG, FAILED_DEPENDENCY or REFUSED.

to.description: The state it entered, one of the same seven.

platform.profile.refused.description: The production profile refused one violation at start-up - a forbidden switch, a risk not accepted, a required setting unset, an unreadable governed value, an unknown OIDF_ name, an unreadable catalogue, or a refusal in code - and the components it names answer 503. One event per violation, from the start-up audit; the reason says what to change.

platform.component.changed.description: A component's state changed in this copy's registry. Counted in oidf_events_total by its code; not audited.
